Signs of autism in children

Children with autism may behave differently from other children. They may find it hard to communicate and interact with other people. These differences appear in early childhood and can affect everyday life in many different ways.

Signs of autism in young children

Common signs include avoiding eye contact, not smiling back, and getting upset if there are loud noises or busy environments. Some children prefer to play alone and may repeat the same actions over and over.
